name: Unbox-in-hook → use (the package opens inside the first 3 s, never later)
status: MECHANIC. Proven as an opener (Brick Hood POV unbag ×2 at ~61K; MF 63K box carried in by 1 s; MG 98K box in hand) and externally (5.2M, 3.2M, 2.6M, 1.8M). As a BODY block, unboxing is the #1 retention leak.
summary: The product comes out of its package during the hook (POV unbag, lid lift, box handed in), then goes straight into use. Pair it with any text family. The rule that makes it work: no unboxing after 3.8 s, and no box shot longer than 2.0 s.
why: Box/unbox shots are where viewers leave: the biggest drop-off falls inside BOX/UNBOX on 6/7 then-vs-now reels (0:04-0:06) (body REPORT §3).
Moving the box into the hook moved the drop-off to 0:11, with 66% watched (MG 98K).

Openers that ARE an unbox: Brick Hood POV_UNBAG 61.3K / 61.1K; MF 63K; external zombie.crawler POV unpack 3.2M; jinglenap pulling a dog bed from its package 1.8M; hollyglow shelf-grab 5.2M; lockedlovestore 'Suprise them ❤️🥹' box on fur 2.6M.

timing.basis: jinglenap 1.8M: 2.33 | 4.07 | 6.37 | 8.10 | END 9.23; zombie.crawler 3.2M: 4.00 | 7.17 | 10.30 | END 12.07 (XA). Internal openers end the unbox at 2.4-3.8 s (MF 2.367, BH 2.733, MG 3.767).

generations.title: POV unbox
generations.basis: B-UNBOX-POV (prompt_templates) compressed into the hook; BH / zombie.crawler POV.
generations.prompt:
POV: hands hold the {brand} box from <<<image_2>>> on denim-clad knees in a festive American living room, flip the lid open within the first second and lift the {product} from <<<image_1>>> up toward the camera so it fills a third of the frame by two seconds. A golden retriever watches. Handheld phone video. Natural sound only, no music, no text.
A small American flag is visible in the background.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.
